lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the Ouray joint work session Monday where city and county officials will hash out a proposed intergovernmental agreement to hand full law enforcement for the City of Ouray over to the Sheriff's Office — starting January 1, 2027 — with public comment built into the session. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a vesting period extension and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras, while San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission both take up affordable housing policy and a public hearing on fee waivers for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley project. There's also a Ballot Measure 5A information meeting Monday on KOTO if you want to get up to speed before November.
